**Finding re-submitted: Compliant** (no redline, no counterparty comment).

- Confirmed absence with additional searches ("non-solicitation", "directly or indirectly", plus the earlier "solicit"/"hire"/"induce"/"recruit"/"employ"/"personnel") — no non-solicit, no-hire, or anti-poaching covenant anywhere in the agreement.
- Cited p0066 (independent contractor / no-agency) as the nearest employment-adjacent text, expressly noting it contains no hiring restriction; this supports rather than contradicts the compliance conclusion.
- Rationale now records that the failed duration and general-solicitation-carve-out sub-checks are inapplicable artifacts of there being no clause to measure.
- Fallback terms retained as an internal note flagged as not for negotiation, so no issue is raised with Kubient.
